about_the_game:
A tale of a cat searching for its lost souls, and an angel wandering in search of an identity.

You are the cat.

Chasing a ball of yarn, you were struck by a carriage. Stealing a fish, you were hit by a flying bottle.
After a series of strange yet “glorious” deaths, your nine lives have dwindled down to one.

Then you found a pair of scissors.
With a snip, fish seemed to multiply into two… three… and so did your remaining soul.
But soon, the fragments scattered everywhere, leaving you broken and incomplete.

A Journey to Reclaim Your Lost Souls

As the cat, you set out to gather the pieces of your soul.

What could have been a simple journey quickly spirals out of control as you meet curious characters and get caught up in unforeseen events. Yet amidst the chaos, joy awaits.

Solve puzzles, uncover stories, and complete the unexpected ending of this tale.

Features

  • Over 60 handcrafted puzzle stages

  • A full 7-chapter main storyline

  • Hidden stories for every character

Gameplay

Clear every enemy on the map and survive until the end.

Movement & Health

  • Once you move in a direction, you’ll keep rolling until you hit a wall or enemy.

  • Each move costs 1 HP.

Enemies

  • Colliding with an enemy lets you defeat it and absorb its health if your HP is greater or equal.

  • If your HP is lower, you stop in front of the enemy and lose health.

Execution

  • Every action consumes a turn. After a set number of turns, the unit with the highest HP on the map is executed.

  • This includes both enemies and you, forcing you to decide: do you hunt enemies to restore HP, or lower your health to avoid execution?

Additional Mechanics & Boss Stages

  • New gimmicks appear as you progress, adding fresh twists to the puzzles.

  • Each chapter culminates in a boss stage featuring powerful foes unlike anything in regular levels.

Main & Hidden Stories

Experience a 7-chapter main story centered on the cat and the angel, and unlock hidden stories for every character.

Complete the ending and discover the secrets behind their intertwined fates.

Can you gather every fragment and reclaim your true self?
